sentences.text: I need to go to the bank to withdraw some money.
sentences.note: 银行。线索是 withdraw money，办的是存取款业务。

sentences.text: The bank refused to lend him the money.
sentences.note: 银行。线索是 lend，金融机构放贷。

sentences.text: They sat on the bank of the river and watched the boats.
sentences.note: 河岸。线索是 river + watched the boats，是水边而不是金融机构。

sentences.text: The house stands on the opposite bank of the lake.
sentences.translation: 那栋房子坐落在湖的对岸。
sentences.note: 河岸，堤岸。线索是 opposite bank of the lake。

sentences.text: The sales figures for last month were better than expected.
sentences.translation: 上个月的销售数字好于预期。
sentences.note: 数字。线索是 sales figures，指统计数据。

sentences.text: Please write the final figure in this box.
sentences.translation: 请把最终数字写在这个方框里。
sentences.note: 数字。线索是 write the final figure，填的是数值。

sentences.text: She became a public figure after the election.
sentences.translation: 选举后她成了公众人物。
sentences.note: 人物。线索是 public figure，指被公众认识的人。

sentences.text: He is a key figure in the local music scene.
sentences.translation: 他是当地音乐圈的关键人物。
sentences.note: 人物。线索是 key figure + music scene，指群体里举足轻重的人。

sentences.text: She watches her diet to keep a slim figure.
sentences.translation: 她注意饮食以保持苗条的身材。
sentences.note: 身材。线索是 slim figure，指体型。

sentences.text: The dress shows off her figure.
sentences.translation: 这条裙子凸显了她的身材。
sentences.note: 身材，体型。线索是 dress + shows off，指衣服衬托身形。

sentences.text: The lab uses sophisticated equipment to analyze the samples.
sentences.translation: 实验室使用精密的设备分析样本。
sentences.note: 复杂精密的。线索是 equipment + analyze，指技术含量高的设备。

sentences.text: This is a sophisticated system that learns from user behavior.
sentences.translation: 这是一个能从用户行为中学习的复杂系统。
sentences.note: 先进的，复杂的。线索是 system + learns，指功能复杂、技术先进。

sentences.text: She is a sophisticated traveler who has visited over forty countries.
sentences.translation: 她是一位见多识广的旅行者，去过四十多个国家。
sentences.note: 见多识广的。线索是 traveler + forty countries，强调阅历丰富。

sentences.text: He has a sophisticated taste in art and music.
sentences.translation: 他在艺术和音乐方面很有品味。
sentences.note: 老练的。线索是 taste in art and music，指审美成熟、有见识。
